In addition to their massive attack on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, Russia attacked four of the bridges across the Dnieper River in Kyiv with around a dozen Iskander-M ballistic missiles. Strikes were carried out on the Patona, Darnytskyi, Southern, and Podilskyi Bridges. Traffic in both directions has been suspended along the Podilskyi Bridge, and restricted in one direction on the Southern Bridge. The condition of the Patona and Podilskyi Bridges is currently unknown.

🇷🇺 Key points from the Russian Defense Ministry's statement: ➡️ Road bridges and a road-rail bridge in Kiev and Kiev region that were being used to transport weapons were struck; ➡️ The road-rail bridge in Zatoka, Odessa region, used to move military cargo, was struck; ➡️ The Fire Point assembly facility in Petrovskoye, Kiev region, was hit; ➡️ A depot in Nikolaev region storing cruise missiles used for strikes on civilian targets in Russia was hit; ➡️ An aircraft plant in Lvov producing FP-9 and FP-5 "Flamingo" missiles was struck; ➡️ A powder metallurgy plant in Brovary, Kiev region, producing components for solid rocket fuel was hit; ➡️ A drone assembly facility in Kiev region that builds strike drones was hit; ➡️ The Burshtyn thermal power plant in Ivano-Frankovsk region, which supplies electricity to defense industry enterprises and Ukrainian military facilities, was struck; ➡️ The PS-110 substation in Chernigov region, which distributes power to defense industry enterprises and military facilities in the region, was hit; ➡️ The Terny-Pervomaiskaya substation in Dnepropetrovsk region, which distributes power to the defense industry, was hit; ➡️ The PS-750 Zapadnoukrainskaya substation in Lvov region, which supplies Ukraine's defense industry, was struck; ➡️ Four locomotives carrying Ukrainian military cargo were hit near the Dnepropetrovsk and Korosten stations; ➡️ A cargo ship delivering military cargo to the port of Odessa was struck. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
